card.line: Penuel, also called Peniel, was a place east of the Jordan where Jacob met God, and later a city that Gideon punished and Jeroboam built up.

moments.title: Jacob leaves limping
moments.text: After Jacob saw God face to face and his life was spared, he named the place Peniel. The sun rose as he passed by Penuel, and he was limping because of his hip.

moments.title: Gideon is refused help
moments.text: Gideon asked the men of Penuel for bread for his tired men while he chased Zebah and Zalmunna. The men of Penuel gave the same answer as Succoth, and Gideon promised to tear down their tower after he won.

moments.title: Gideon tears down the tower
moments.text: After Gideon captured Zebah and Zalmunna, he pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.

moments.title: Jeroboam builds Penuel
moments.text: Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and built Penuel.
